text: "Welcome, find a comfortable position, let your hands rest easily and allow your
eyes to close. Take a gentle breath in, and exhale slowly. Again, breathing in presence,
breathing out release.
Feel the surface beneath you, steady and supportive.
You are safe to let go.
your breath, each breath softening the body, each breath preparing you for a shift.
Now imagine yourself standing on a quiet path.
Behind you is the timeline you have lived until this moment.
All the experiences, all the lessons, all the versions of you.
See this path stretching back, fading into the distance.
it gratitude.
Everything that came before has carried you here.
Now turn your awareness forward.
Before you the path begins to branch into infinite directions.
Each path a possible future, each one vibrating with a different frequency.
You notice one path glowing brighter than the rest.
It feels alive, expansive, calling you forward.
This is the timeline of your highest self, the one aligned with your true essence, your
fullest potential.
Take a step toward this glowing path.
Notice how it feels beneath your feet, solid, luminous, alive.
With every breath, you feel yourself shifting into resonance with it.
Now with your imagination, release the old timeline.
See it gently dissolving behind you like mist.
Thank it once more and let it fade.
You no longer need to carry it.
Stand fully on this new path.
Feel the energy of your highest self surrounding you.
See this version of you walking forward, clear, steady, radiant.
Notice how they hold themselves, how they breathe, how they move through the world.
Now step into them.
March completely with this version of yourself.
Feel the alignment.
Feel the expansion.
Feel the clarity of walking your highest path.
Silently repeat.
I release what is complete.
I align with my highest self.
I walk my true path
Again
Let these words ripple through your body, your mind, your spirit, anchoring you fully
into this new frequency.
Take a few moments simply walking this path in your awareness.
Missing the colors, the sensations, the energy of what lies ahead.
Trusting it, embodying it, becoming it.
Now return to your breath.
Inhale presence, exhale steadiness, know that this shift is complete, that you are walking
your highest timeline, here and now.
Take a final deep inhale, exhale fully.
Begin to bring awareness back to the body, the air on your skin, the surface supporting
you.
When you feel ready, gently open your eyes.
Carry this alignment with you into every step of your day.
